headline: Al-Khalayleh: Islamic Sukuk Are a Legitimate Financing Tool That Contributes to Investing Liquidity
summary: Jordan's Minister of Awqaf said the kingdom has clear legislation regulating Islamic sukuk. He noted Jordan was among the first countries to set a legal framework for Islamic finance.
why: Sukuk are Sharia-compliant bonds used by governments and companies to raise capital, making them relevant to Gulf and Islamic finance investors.
